label: Bible Study
prompt: Be ye _____, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
verse: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
note: Anger isn't banned here — just given a sundown curfew.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the _____ through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verse: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
note: The end of Paul's great resurrection chapter: death has lost its sting, so it ends with a thank-you.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive _____ pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
verse: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
note: The peace symbol says olive branch, but Noah's dove actually brought back an olive leaf, freshly 'pluckt off.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: Ye have sown much, and bring in little; ye eat, but ye have not enough; ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink; ye clothe you, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with _____.
verse: Ye have sown much, and bring in little; ye eat, but ye have not enough; ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink; ye clothe you, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes.
note: Haggai's audit for returned exiles who paneled their own houses while the temple lay in ruins: wages in a leaky purse.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy _____.
verse: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
note: Among the Old Testament verses most quoted in the New — Jesus used it to stump the Pharisees in Matthew 22.
